decisions.reason: The source changes the reference-alignment and benefit-selection direction, but it does not change the existing keyword sources or wording constraints.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records the winning script and last reference script as benefit sources and requires combining their additional benefits.
The request to create something similar to the last reference does not explicitly or necessarily alter the established direct viral hook criteria.
The source does not state that the testimonial presentation must be replaced, and reference similarity can coexist with the current testimonial format.
The revised source-material direction does not change the CPL target or conversion-focused performance objective.
The source does not modify the Hindi-only script or dialogue requirement.
The source does not change the audience age range or Indian-market targeting.
The source contains no change to the required organic call to action.
The creative-reference change does not alter the duration, language, content, or approval purpose of the preview clip.
The source does not change the video count, duration, or required aspect ratios.
The source does not change the freelancer's full-service production responsibility or supplied production elements.
The source changes creative-reference and benefit inputs but does not alter the established visual realism or native-looking UGC criteria.
